messages.subject: Model averaged coefficients [feature question]
parts:
Having recently made the conversion to Bayes, I was wondering if there's any way to get model averaged coefficients, similar to what the model.avg function does in the 

 ‘MuMIn’ package. I see that the pp_average allows calculating weighted values for predicting but I can't seem to find a way to recover the weighted coefficients it uses to make these weighted predictions. 

Great package by the way... was super easy to learn after using lme4 and the base R functions for linear models

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Model averaged coefficients [feature question]
parts:
pp_average does not actually average coefficients. It directly averages posterior-predictive samples.

This may qualify as a new feature. Feel free to open an issue on github for this.
